title: This Accessory Gives Your Old Apple Watch A New Lease Of Life - BGR
summary: Compatible with Apple Watch 4 through 9 and all three Apple Watch Ultras, the tinyPod houses your bandless Apple smartwatch. Plenty of Apple Watch features work without even needing your phone nearby .
